# FlowFinding { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowFinding }

```python
timelines.FlowFinding(kind, coordinate, end, message, cause=None)
```

Something playing flow control found.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name       | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                        |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| kind       | [FlowFindingKind](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowFindingKind`)           | What was found.                                                                                                                                                    |
| coordinate | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                           | Where: the element's coordinate, or the start of a stretch never played.                                                                                           |
| end        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| None                   | The end of a stretch never played; None otherwise.                                                                                                                 |
| message    | [str](`str`)                                                          | The finding as a sentence.                                                                                                                                         |
| cause      | [FlowFindingCause](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowFindingCause`) \| None | Why the convention played found it: ``single_playback`` for a stretch the ``single`` flow leaves out and the ``default`` flow plays; None for every other finding. |
